overall_goal: Prepare ingredients and equipment for cooking, including weighing potatoes, cleaning up, and retrieving utensils.

goals.rationale: The person picks up and reads the recipe card to check the instructions.

goals.description: Retrieve potatoes and mushrooms from the fridge.
goals.rationale: The person opens the fridge, takes out potatoes and mushrooms, and places them on the counter.

goals.description: Retrieve a bowl and a scale from the cupboards.
goals.rationale: The person opens the cupboards to get a bowl and a kitchen scale, placing them on the counter.

goals.description: Set up the scale and attempt to weigh the bag of potatoes.
goals.rationale: The person prepares the bag of potatoes, turns on the scale, and tries to weigh the whole bag using the bowl.

goals.description: Weigh the potatoes individually and turn off the scale.
goals.rationale: The person takes potatoes out of the bag to weigh them individually in the bowl, decides to use the extra ones, and turns off the scale.

goals.description: Put away the scale and dispose of the empty potato bag.
goals.rationale: The person moves the scale aside and throws the empty plastic potato bag into the recycling bin.

goals.description: Retrieve a plastic colander from the cupboard.
goals.rationale: The person opens the bottom cupboard to get a plastic colander and places it next to the sink.

goals.description: Clear the sink and load dirty cups into the dishwasher.
goals.rationale: The person moves items out of the sink and places dirty cups into the dishwasher.

goals.description: Drain the washed potatoes in the colander.
goals.rationale: The person turns off the tap and transfers the washed potatoes into the colander to drain.

goals.description: Rinse the bowl and dry hands.
goals.rationale: The person rinses the bowl used for weighing, places it on the drying rack, and dries their hands.

goals.description: Retrieve a peeler from the cupboard.
goals.rationale: The person searches the cupboards and retrieves a peeler from the cutlery tray.
The person washes potato starch off their hands and dries them with a cloth.

goals.description: Retrieve a large saucepan from the cupboard.
goals.rationale: The person opens the top cupboard, moves smaller saucepans aside, and takes out a large saucepan.

goals.description: Transfer chopped potatoes into the saucepan.
goals.rationale: The person scoops up the chopped potato chunks from the chopping board and drops them into the saucepan.
